practices.title: AGENTS.md holds the repository rules
practices.fix: Write AGENTS.md from references/practices.md#agents-md; keep rules, link guides.

practices.title: CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md
practices.fix: Run scripts/apply.py <project> --practice claude-imports-agents.

practices.title: Agent Toolkit plugins are enabled for the repository
practices.fix: Run scripts/apply.py <project> --practice toolkit-plugins.

practices.title: Agents can reach every agent-relevant product feature
practices.fix: List each feature's agent surface (CLI, API or MCP tool) in the feature catalog; review new MCP servers with security-ai.

practices.title: The shared writing policy is installed in AGENTS.md
practices.fix: Run document-software scripts/install_policy.py <project> --check, then --write.

practices.title: The root README is the front door
practices.fix: Write README.md with purpose, status, quick start, verification and documentation links.

practices.title: docs/README.md maps the documentation
practices.fix: Add docs/README.md from document-software references/templates.md (Documentation map).

practices.title: A current architecture overview exists
practices.fix: Add docs/architecture/overview.md from document-software references/templates.md.

practices.title: A feature catalog lists what the product does now
practices.fix: Add docs/features/README.md and one page per feature from document-software references/templates.md.

practices.title: Engineering guides cover recurring kinds of change
practices.fix: Add docs/engineering/<guide>.md for a recurring change and link it from AGENTS.md.

practices.title: CI checks documentation links and the catalog
practices.fix: Run document-software scripts/docs_check.py (or an equivalent link checker) in CI.

practices.title: One command runs the full quality gate
practices.fix: Add one script (for example `validate` or `make check`) that runs format, lint, type and test checks, and name it in AGENTS.md.

practices.title: The toolchain version is pinned
practices.fix: Pin the runtime and package manager (.nvmrc, packageManager, .python-version, rust-toolchain.toml or .tool-versions).

practices.title: Dependencies are locked
practices.fix: Commit the package manager's lockfile and install from it in CI.

practices.title: Pull requests use a template
practices.fix: Add .github/pull_request_template.md with summary, verification and documentation lines.

practices.title: CI runs on every pull request
practices.fix: Add a workflow triggered on pull_request that runs the quality gate.

practices.title: SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability
practices.fix: Add SECURITY.md with the reporting channel and supported versions.

practices.title: Dependency updates are automated
practices.fix: Add .github/dependabot.yml or a Renovate config with a cooldown.

practices.title: Commits are scanned for secrets
practices.fix: Run gitleaks, trufflehog or an equivalent in pre-commit and CI.

practices.title: CI actions are pinned to commit SHAs
practices.fix: Pin every `uses:` to a full commit SHA with a version comment.

practices.title: A threat model covers the deployed system
practices.fix: Build a threat model with security-threat-model and keep it under docs/security/.

practices.title: Releases follow a written, checked procedure
practices.fix: Write the release steps (preflight, tag, publish, verify, roll back) as a runbook and link it from AGENTS.md.
